author: Unity
description:
Learn how to set up and launch your first Unity Ads user acquisition campaign. 

In this video, we’ll walk you through adding your game, choosing a campaign type (ROAS, Installs, Retention, or Creative Testing), configuring your budget, connecting your MMP, and hitting “Go Live” with confidence. 

🔗 Check out the Unity Ads best practices Ebook to level up your Unity Ads campaigns: https://on.unity.com/UABestPractices
